payload.subject: The follow-up sequence that books calls overnight
payload.html:
Hey {{first_name}},


Here's an uncomfortable question.


How many people asked about your services this month and never heard back a second time?


This isn't for everyone.


If you already follow up with every single inquiry — three or four times, without fail — this one's not for you.


Skip to the next email.


But if you're like most independent service-based businesses, that follow-up happens once, if at all.


Then life gets busy.


And the lead goes quiet.


The old way is a sticky note or a mental reminder to “circle back.”


The AI Growth Engine way is a follow-up sequence that runs on its own.


It texts. It emails. It keeps showing up until someone books.


We see the same pattern across independent service-based businesses.


The ones with an automatic sequence book more consultations than the ones relying on memory.


Not because their offer is better.


Because the follow-up actually happens.


Want me to put together a custom AI + marketing plan for {{business_name}}?


Book a quick discovery call — grab a time here.


Talk soon,


Dylan | Digigrowth


P.S. — this isn't a sales pitch, just 20 minutes to see if The AI Growth Engine fits {{business_name}}.



Unsubscribe
